title: Spreading Joy and Sharing Happiness with Children
excerpt: Megh Foundation celebrates festivals with underprivileged children to build inclusion, belonging, and joyful childhood experiences.
coverImageAlt: Festival celebration with children in an underserved community
bodyMarkdown:
## Why this initiative matters

Festivals should be moments of joy for every child. Megh Foundation organizes celebration events with underprivileged children so they can experience togetherness, care, and community.

## What these celebrations include

- Group activities and games
- Shared festive moments and interaction
- Confidence-building through participation
- Inclusion-focused community engagement

## Impact

When children feel seen and included in social celebrations, their confidence and emotional well-being improve. The initiative strengthens both childhood dignity and community bonds.
